[EN] Go to Flight Manager Kelling at the southern gate and ask if he has seen Govan.

[EN] "They will pay!"

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Govan at the Jungle Patrol Camp southwest of the village.
[ES] Encuentra a Govan en el Jungle Patrol Camp, al suroeste del pueblo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I won't let you down."
[ES] "No te defraudaré".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Prefect Ilaria at the Jungle Patrol Camp.
[ES] Habla con el prefecto Ilaria en el Jungle Patrol Camp.
